title: Trust and Safety Routing Note on Driver Report Volume — Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
Reports are counted per driver across all riders and trips. When a report brings the driver's count to the report review threshold or more, support may not approve it: it stays with Trust and Safety, and the only support action is a policy-not-covered handoff. Below the threshold, reports are reviewed by support in the usual way.

This note applies to every Cleaning and Damage Fees report, at every fee level. The threshold and the lookback are the level's report review threshold (4 reports) and report lookback (30 calendar days).

## How the count is taken

- **Whose reports.** Every assessment raised by the same reporting driver, whichever rider it is against and whichever trip it is on.
- **Which window.** The report lookback in calendar days ending on the report date of the report in question, both ends of the window included.
- **What is counted.** Each assessment whose report moment falls in that window, the report in question included.
- **Authority.** The count is read from the system record of the driver's reports, tied to the reporting driver; it is not taken from what the driver says.

## Effect at and around the threshold

| Driver's count including the report in question | Can support approve the report? |
|---|---|
| below 4 | Yes — the report is reviewed by support in the usual way |
| 4 or more | No — the report stays with Trust and Safety, and the only support action is a policy-not-covered handoff |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical dates)

A report is registered on 30 May. The 30-day window runs from 1 May through 30 May, both days included.

- The driver has two other reports dated 3 May and 21 May. With the report in question the count is 3, below the threshold: support reviews it in the usual way.
- The driver has three other reports dated 1 May, 12 May and 29 May. With the report in question the count is 4, at the threshold: support may not approve it.
- A report dated 30 April falls outside the window and is not counted.
